_meta.definition: The process of managing passenger data, including registration, updates, and personal details.

passenger._description: Tracks individual passengers and their identifying details at the airport.

columns.name: passenger_id
columns.description: Primary key uniquely identifying each row in passenger

columns.name: passportno
columns.description: Stores unique 10-character alphanumeric passport numbers of passengers.

columns.name: firstname
columns.description: Stores up to 50 characters of passengers' first names, including some with middle initials.

columns.name: lastname
columns.description: Stores up to 50 characters of the surname for passengers.

passengerdetails._description: Captures personal details of individual passengers for air travel management.

columns.name: passenger_id
columns.description: Primary key uniquely identifying each row in passengerdetails

columns.name: birthdate
columns.description: Stores passenger birthdates in YYYY-MM-DD format.

columns.name: sex
columns.description: Stores passenger gender (male or female) as a character string.

columns.name: street
columns.description: Stores street addresses of passengers, up to 50 characters long.

columns.name: city
columns.description: Stores names of cities where passengers reside.

columns.name: country
columns.description: Stores passenger's country of origin (Ethiopia, Korea, Denmark, United States).

columns.name: emailaddress
columns.description: Stores email addresses of passengers in a format compatible with standard internet email services.

columns.name: telephoneno
columns.description: Stores international phone numbers up to 15 digits.
